content.rendered:
The Middleton staff realizes that parents provide valuable information regarding their child’s placement. While we do not take requests for specific teachers, parent input will be carefully considered in the formation of classes for the 2020-2021 school year. Our class placement process is a collaborative one and our Placement Team takes into account a number of factors when forming classes: boy/girl ratio, personalities, academic levels, learning styles, learning needs, and student compatibility. We look at each student as an individual and as a member of a diverse class. This information will be given careful consideration.  Every effort will be made to provide the most appropriate educational setting for your child and to establish well-balanced classrooms.


This is not a teacher request form. Any form turned in with a specific teacher’s name request will not be considered. 


If you are interested in providing placement input, please complete the Parent Input Survey no later than 5 pm on Wednesday, May 13, 2020.
